description: Official person ids for candidacies: the Houses of the Oireachtas member code, the Northern Ireland Assembly's AIMS person id, the UK Parliament member id and Democracy Club's person id. Read by the election manifest (a candidate's officialPersonIds) and by the person registry, where one id is one person and two ids of the same system are two people. Matched 2026-10-23 on election, constituency and name; low-confidence matches are left out.
